notes.title: Rocket Jumps!
notes.content:
For its one-year anniversary, Cartacombs has a new feature: rocket jumps! For those pesky times when you simply run out of track, your cart can now use a rocket-boost to pull you from the clutches of the abyss! It takes ten seconds to recharge, so use it wisely in the later stages.

As part of this update, Cartacombs will be 75% off for 2 weeks, starting February 28th!
